# American Petroleum Institute (API)

> > The American Petroleum Institute is the leading U.S. trade association representing over 600 oil and natural gas companies, setting industry standards and advocating for energy policy.

API serves as the primary standards-setting organization for the petroleum industry, offering certification programs, technical standards (available through their webstore), and policy advocacy on climate, infrastructure, and trade issues. The organization represents companies supporting over 11 million American jobs across the energy sector.

## Key Topics

- American Petroleum Institute (API)
- API Standards and Certification
- Climate Policy and Low-Carbon Technologies
- Oil and Gas Industry
- Energy Infrastructure and Permitting
- Pipeline Safety (PHMSA)
- Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS)
- Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)
- Global Industry Services (GIS)
- Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reporting
- Renewable Fuel Standard
- Tax Policy for Energy Sector
- Trade and Global Markets
- NEPA Permitting Reform

## About API

- [About API](https://www.api.org/about): API's mission representing 600 oil & gas members with standards and advocacy
- [Membership](https://www.api.org/membership): Join API's trade association supporting 11M+ energy jobs across US, Canada
- [Global Industry Services (GIS)](https://www.api.org/products-and-services): API's certification programs, standards, and safety assessment services
- [API Webstore](https://www.api.org/webstore): Purchase API standards including STD 1104, STD 650, and SPEC 6A

## Policy & Issues

- [Issues](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues): API policy positions on climate, infrastructure, trade, and energy issues
- [Energy Agenda](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/energy-agenda): NEPA permitting reform, pipeline safety, and federal lands energy policy
- [Energy Insights](https://www.api.org/energy-insights): API's framework for clean energy, technology, and climate policy progress
- [Infrastructure & Permitting](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/infrastructure-permitting): Pipeline regulation and federal permitting reform for energy infrastructure
- [Tax Policy](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/tax): API's tax policy advocacy for US oil and natural gas industry
- [Fuels & Refining](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/fuels-refining): Renewable Fuel Standard, NAAQS, and refining industry policy positions

## Climate & Low-Carbon Technologies

- [Low Carbon Technologies](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/climate/low-carbon): Carbon capture, CCS, hydrogen, and decarbonization technologies overview
- [GHG Reporting](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/climate/ghg-reporting): API guidance and templates for voluntary greenhouse gas emissions reporting

## News & Updates

- [News](https://www.api.org/news): API press releases and oil & gas industry news updates
- [The Real-Life 'Landman'](https://www.api.org/reallandman): Landman roles in oil & gas operations with API RP 54 safety standards

## COVID-19 Resources

- [Federal Pandemic Resources](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/trade-global-markets/federal-pandemic-resources): Federal COVID-19 resources from WHO and CDC for energy sector operations
- [State Pandemic Resources](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/trade-global-markets/state-pandemic-resources): State-level pandemic guidance for critical energy infrastructure operations
- [CARES Act Resources](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/trade-global-markets/cares-act-resources): CARES Act COVID relief programs including PPP for energy businesses
- [API Products & Services Pandemic Covid-19 Alerts](https://www.api.org/news-policy-and-issues/trade-global-markets/api-products-and-services-pandemic-resources): COVID-19 updates for API certification, training, and Monogram programs
